title: Fulfillment Fee Assessment on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
The fulfillment fee on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders is assessed once per order. Which amount applies turns on the customer's membership with Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus on the order date and on the order's merchandise subtotal.

## The rule

- A customer whose Tailwise Plus tier is active, or in status pending downgrade, pays the method's Tailwise Plus fee.
- Otherwise, where the method waives its fee at the threshold and the order's merchandise subtotal reaches the free-shipping order threshold of the customer's Pals Rewards tier on the order date, no fee is charged.
- Otherwise the method's fulfillment fee is charged.
- A customer without a membership uses the Pals Rewards Member threshold.
- Same-Day Delivery needs a merchandise subtotal of at least the method's minimum merchandise subtotal.
- Orders are never combined across order numbers to reach a threshold, and certificates do not reduce the subtotal used for the threshold.

**Merchandise subtotal.** The merchandise subtotal of an order is the total, over its line charges, of quantity times unit price less the coupon allocated to the line, before certificates.

## Decision table

| Tailwise Plus tier active or pending downgrade | Method waives its fee at the threshold | Merchandise subtotal reaches the Pals Rewards threshold | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | any | The method's Tailwise Plus fee |
| No | Yes | Yes | No fee |
| No | Yes | No | The method's fulfillment fee |
| No | No | any | The method's fulfillment fee |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- *At the threshold.* A hypothetical Standard Ship-to-Home order has a merchandise subtotal of $49.00 and the customer's Pals Rewards tier carries a hypothetical $49.00 threshold. The subtotal reaches the threshold, so no fee is charged.
- *Certificate on the order.* The same order paid with a hypothetical $10.00 certificate still has a $49.00 subtotal for the threshold, because certificates do not reduce it; no fee is charged.
- *Two orders.* Two hypothetical orders of $30.00 each are assessed one by one; neither reaches a $49.00 threshold and the two are never added together.
- *Plus member.* A customer with a Tailwise Plus tier in status pending downgrade pays the method's Tailwise Plus fee whatever the subtotal.
